svg.title: XX. The Release Bell: batmon
svg.desc: XX. The Release Bell, reversed. Software. Dead simple battery monitor in Go, with the ability to emit events on change.. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), Nimrod and his horn. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 324. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
